listings.name: Gegrond
listings.current_description: Gegrond is a specialty coffee roastery in Murrayfield that has roasted and supplied premium coffee beans since 2019, growing into a nationally recognised brand and placing first in the 'A Shot In The Dark 2021' roasting competition.

listings.name: Global Phone and Security
listings.current_description: Global Phone and Security has been importing, reselling and installing security, automation and self-defence products since 1999, supplying CCTV cameras, access control, intercoms and alarm systems, and installing gate motors for residential and commercial clients in Magalieskruin.

listings.name: Ground UP Water Pumps
listings.current_description: Ground UP Water Pumps is a water-pump supplier and installer based in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, and a service partner of DAB Water Technology, providing installation, maintenance and diagnostic services for water pumps at homes, farms and businesses.

listings.name: Hennopspark Auto Repair Shop
listings.current_description: Hennopspark Auto Repair Shop is an all-in-one vehicle repair, maintenance and servicing shop in Centurion, also offering auto electrical work, panel beating and spray painting, serving customers across Pretoria, Johannesburg, Sandton, Midrand, Fourways, Hartbeespoort and Kempton Park.

listings.name: Hilti Store Silverton
listings.current_description: A Hilti store in Silverton selling cordless power tools, fastening and anchoring systems, firestop and construction chemicals, and offering fleet management and tool repair services, part of a construction technology brand with 80 years of industry experience.

listings.name: iCAM Video Telematics
listings.current_description: A fleet video telematics provider serving Blue Valley Golf Estate and the wider Centurion area, supplying vehicle video systems, GPS tracking, ADAS and driver fatigue detection technology with 24/7 monitoring for transport, construction and mining fleets.

listings.name: INOAR Lifestyle Centre
listings.current_description: INOAR Lifestyle Centre in Nieuw Muckleneuk combines a hair and beauty salon offering balayage, hair extensions, keratin treatments and permanent straightening with a retail area and coffee shop, its design inspired by the Inoar brand's Brazilian roots.

listings.name: INPAKT GROUP
listings.current_description: INPAKT GROUP is a packaging industry supplier based in Zandfontein, Pretoria, with over 22 years of experience manufacturing and supplying packaging machines and food preservation and canning equipment for meat, fish, jams, sauces, vegetables and ready meals.

listings.name: Iridium Business Solutions
listings.current_description: Iridium Business Solutions is an accounting, advisory and automation firm that has spent over 10 years empowering South African entrepreneurs, offering bookkeeping, tax and CFO-support services, and has been named Xero South Africa's Partner of the Year.

listings.name: Izinso Dialysis Pretoria West
listings.current_description: Izinso Dialysis Pretoria West is a branch of Izinso Dialysis Services, a South African renal healthcare provider established in 2014, offering chronic haemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis, pre-dialysis screening and other renal care services from its Proclamation Hill clinic.

listings.name: Jabulani Design Studio
listings.current_description: Jabulani Design Studio is a graphic and web design company that has served the Centurion, Pretoria, Midrand and Johannesburg area since 2004, offering logo design and branding, website design and development, corporate identity and annual report design.

listings.name: Jacques Orton Architects
listings.current_description: Jacques Orton Architects is a full-service architecture and design firm in Rietondale, founded in 2010, working on residences, cabins, lodges, places of worship and hospitality projects with a focus on designs rooted in local materials and place.

listings.name: JaJa Tea Garden
listings.current_description: JaJa Tea Garden is a cafe and restaurant set within the Tuingenoot Nursery in Clubview, serving coffee, pancakes, light meals and cakes alongside its signature JaJa burger, with indoor and outdoor seating and a children's play area.

listings.name: Juan Oosthuizen Biokineticist Eldoraigne, Centurion
listings.current_description: A biokinetics practice in Eldoraigne, Centurion offering exercise therapy, injury rehabilitation and prevention, pilates, sports performance, running and cycling coaching, gait analysis and medical fitness assessments, operating as part of a multidisciplinary team alongside physiotherapists and dietitians.

listings.name: KEMS Environmental Services
listings.current_description: KEMS Environmental Services is an environmental consultancy based in Celtisdal, Centurion, providing Environmental Impact Assessments, Basic Assessments and Scoping processes under South Africa's National Environmental Management Act, including for activities such as waste storage, processing and disposal.

listings.name: Lauriston Guesthouse
listings.current_description: A European-style guesthouse in Glen Lauriston offering air-conditioned rooms with DSTV and Wi-Fi, two outdoor swimming pools, indoor and outdoor entertainment areas, and complimentary breakfast, awarded a four-star grading by the Tourism Grading Council of South Africa.

listings.name: Lavoro Steel & Roofing
listings.current_description: A steel roofing manufacturer in Kameeldrift established in 2008, producing pierced-fix roof sheeting profiles, flashings, rainwater goods and field toilets with a typical 2-3 day turnaround, supplying hardware retailers across Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Limpopo and the Northern Cape.

listings.name: LimsTricS
listings.current_description: A Laboratory Information Management Systems implementation firm in Hazeldean, the authorised distributor and strategic implementation partner for Thermo Fisher Scientific's SampleManager LIMS across Sub-Saharan Africa since 1998, having deployed South Africa's largest single LIMS rollout at Eskom.

listings.name: Liquor City Magalieskruin
listings.current_description: Liquor City Magalieskruin is a branch of the Liquor City retail chain, selling wines, spirits and beer at the corner of Braam Pretorius Street and Gryshout Road in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, open Monday to Saturday and Sunday mornings.

listings.name: Lombard Tyres Pretoria
listings.current_description: Lombard Tyres Pretoria, part of one of South Africa's largest independent tyre retailers, stocks multi-brand tyres and alloy wheels including Goodyear, Continental, Michelin, Dunlop, Pirelli and Bridgestone, and offers professional fitment with wheel balancing and old-tyre disposal.

listings.name: Lynnridge Timbers
listings.current_description: Lynnridge Timbers, established in 2001, is a family-owned wholesaler and retailer of timber products including gum poles, thatching laths, structural and rough-sawn pine, fencing material, decking and timber treatment products, marketing itself as 'Gauteng's Timber Source.'

listings.name: Lynnwood Law Offices
listings.current_description: Lynnwood Law Offices provides fully furnished serviced office space for practising attorneys in Lynnwood, including boardrooms, a legal library, Docex facilities, reception services and secure parking, letting tenant lawyers focus on legal work rather than office administration.

listings.name: Maake Clement Inc. Attorneys
listings.current_description: Maake Clement Inc. Attorneys is a Pretoria North law firm offering services in corporate law, family law, criminal defence and debt collection, and providing legal support to municipalities and state-owned entities on corporate governance and commercial transactions.

listings.name: Macado Security Viewer
listings.current_description: Trading as Macado Technologies, this Garsfontein company specializes in remote offsite security monitoring and video verification, running a 24-hour control room alongside CCTV, alarm, access control and armed response services designed to reduce reliance on manned guarding.

listings.name: Mamre Property Management
listings.current_description: Mamre Property Management is an estate agency established in 1999, registered with the Estate Agency Affairs Board, specialising in the management of Bodies Corporate, Home Owners Associations, and shopping complexes across Wapadrand and the wider Pretoria area.

listings.name: Mandla Fitment Centre
listings.current_description: Mandla Fitment Centre, based at Wonderpark Shopping Centre in Karenpark, is a fully licensed and insured window tinting specialist offering automotive smash-and-grab safety film as well as residential and commercial window tinting, backed by a 7-year warranty.

listings.name: Meat World Elardus Park
listings.current_description: Meat World in Elardus Park stocks fresh, frozen and processed beef, pork and chicken, with a pre-packed section offering ready-cut meat plus cheeses, dairy products, spices and sauces, and can also arrange bulk wholesale buying and delivery.

listings.name: Merakology Creative Studio
listings.current_description: Merakology Creative Studio is a graphic design and branding partner based in Constantia Park, offering laser engraving and cutting on items such as mugs, yoga blocks, leather gifts and wine boxes, alongside digital printing and signage solutions.

listings.name: Metropolitan Wonderpark
listings.current_description: Metropolitan's Wonderpark branch offers insurance and financial services from within Wonderpark Shopping Centre, one of South Africa's largest regional shopping centres with more than 300 stores, at the corner of Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark.

listings.name: Meyerspark Mica
listings.current_description: Meyerspark Mica is a member-owned outlet of the Mica hardware group, one of Africa's largest hardware retail networks with over 160 stores, stocking hardware, power tools, paint, garden and pool care, and building supplies locally in Meyerspark.

listings.name: MFH Chartered Accountants Inc.
listings.current_description: MFH Chartered Accountants Inc. forms part of the MFH Group, alongside MFH Consulting CC, and provides assurance, taxation, advisory and B-BBEE verification services to private and government sector clients of all sizes across Gauteng and North West.

listings.name: Midrand Grinders
listings.current_description: Midrand Grinders has more than 30 years of experience in the engineering industry, offering milling, turning, surface grinding, CNC machining, and machine knife manufacturing and sharpening to the mining, industrial and engineering sectors from its Hennopspark workshop.

listings.name: Mike's Kitchen Head Office
listings.current_description: This is the head office of the Mike's Kitchen family restaurant chain, based in the Finforum Centre in Montana; the chain itself traces back to the first Mike's Kitchen, which opened in Greenside, Johannesburg, in September 1972.

listings.name: Mobile kitchen trailers for sale, food trailers , Pretoria, mpumalanga, Gauteng,limpopo, North west, kzn, Bloemfontein ,
listings.current_description: This business manufactures and repairs custom mobile trailers -- including mobile kitchen and food trailers, VIP toilets, mobile freezers and cold rooms, and mobile bars and stages -- serving customers across Gauteng, Durban, North West and Mpumalanga.

listings.name: Montana Carwash & Valet Specialists
listings.current_description: Montana Carwash & Valet Specialists, in Montana, Pretoria, offers wash, dry and vacuum services, chassis and engine cleaning, valeting, carpet and upholstery cleaning, and cleaning for boats, caravans and camping equipment, with eight years in the industry.

listings.name: Montana Gables Office Park
listings.current_description: Montana Gables Office Park is a multi-tenanted A-grade office park on Escallonia Street, Montana Park, Pretoria, with units ranging from around 106 to 124 square metres featuring reception areas, boardrooms and kitchen facilities, near Kolonnade Retail Park.

listings.name: Mooiplaas Iris & Daylily Nursery, Erasmia, Centurion
listings.current_description: Mooiplaas Iris & Daylily Nursery, in Erasmia, Centurion, is a specialist online grower of irises, daylilies and bulbous plants, delivering nationwide by courier with free shipping on orders above R850; in-person visits are by prior arrangement only.

listings.name: MRA - Regulatory Consultants
listings.current_description: MRA Regulatory Consultants is a business consulting firm established in 2003 that provides regulatory affairs and advisory services to the pharmaceutical industry, covering orthodox and complementary medicines, medical devices, facility licensing and GMP compliance across South Africa.

listings.name: MRK Construction & Projects
listings.current_description: MRK Construction & Projects is a 100 percent black-owned and managed construction company with over 16 years of experience, offering house building, thatch roofing including Harvey-on-thatch, as well as slabs, concrete work, renovations, plumbing, painting and tiling.

listings.name: MSR Solutions (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: MSR Solutions is a black-owned solar company based in Celtisdal that designs and installs grid-tied solar power systems for homes, offices and schools, helping clients cut electricity costs and stay protected against load shedding and power outages.

listings.name: Myriad Green - Irrigation, Backup Water Systems & Leak Detection.
listings.current_description: Myriad Green provides irrigation system installation, repair and fault-finding, along with backup water solutions such as JoJo tank and borehole-linked systems, and hidden/underground leak detection for homes, estates, schools and commercial properties across Pretoria and Centurion.

listings.name: Network Alliance (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Network Alliance (Pty) Ltd is a managed IT and cloud services provider based in Zwartkop, Centurion, offering network design, implementation and day-to-day infrastructure management alongside managed security services such as advanced content filtering, antivirus and firewall protection.

listings.name: NEXUS TRANSMISSION COMPONENTS
listings.current_description: Nexus Transmission Components is an engineering sourcing partner supplying precision drive components and heavy-duty conveyor chains, including gears, couplings, chains, bearings, locking elements, and universal joints, with access to over 40,000 German-engineered parts and engineering support.

listings.name: OBARO Online
listings.current_description: OBARO Online is the e-commerce arm of agricultural supplier OBARO, based in Silver Lakes Golf Estate, Pretoria East, offering farm equipment such as tractors and irrigation systems alongside a wide range of agricultural products for online ordering.

listings.name: Office Co. - Menlyn
listings.current_description: Office Co. - Menlyn, based in Ashlea Gardens Office Park at the junction of Garsfontein Road and the N1, offers fully furnished office suites, co-working space and virtual offices, with meeting facilities, cleaning and unlimited WiFi included.

listings.name: OpenSky Solar Energy Solutions
listings.current_description: OpenSky Solar Energy Solutions is an ECSA-accredited solar company in Eldoraigne, Centurion, designing and installing domestic and commercial PV systems including grid-tied solar, hybrid inverters and battery backup, plus solar water heating and system maintenance and repairs.

listings.name: Oppi Hoek Guesthouse
listings.current_description: Oppi Hoek Guesthouse is a bed and breakfast in Riviera, Pretoria, offering single, double and twin en-suite rooms with DSTV, Wi-Fi, an indoor braai area and an on-site restaurant, close to the Union Buildings and Church Square.

listings.name: Palladium Hair Co
listings.current_description: Palladium Hair Co operates from Waterkloof Heights Shopping Centre as part of a high-fashion, progressive hair salon brand founded in 1997 that also has a presence in Cape Town. The salon offers hair, nail and beauty services.

listings.name: Paralia
listings.current_description: Paralia, on the corner of Graham and Boschkop roads in Zwavelpoort, is a Mediterranean-style restaurant and beach bar (formerly @ The Beach Restaurant) serving small plates, tapas, seafood and grilled meats across renovated indoor and outdoor seating areas.

listings.name: Pc Bugs Computer Reairs
listings.current_description: Pc Bugs Computer Repairs has provided on-site computer maintenance to businesses and individuals in Pretoria since 2012, specialising in data recovery, virus and spyware removal, network monitoring, desktop and laptop repairs, and custom-built desktop computers and servers.
